nodes.name: Webhook (patient reply)
nodes.notes: Fired by trg_notify_n8n_inbound on every patient message INSERT. Payload: { type:'inbound_reply', message_id, conversation_id, body, channel, sent_at }. After activating, set private.app_config.n8n_inbound_webhook_url to this node's Production URL.

nodes.name: Verify secret
nodes.notes: II_WEBHOOK_SECRET = private.app_config.n8n_webhook_secret. False branch is a dead end (bad/forged request).

nodes.name: agent_context
nodes.notes: Returns conversation_type + clinic_name + patient + messages[]. conversation_type is what lets us route ACCEPT/DECLINE to the right slot RPC below.

nodes.name: Route
nodes.notes: The brain of WF-A. slot_cascade + ACCEPT -> cascade_respond_accept, + DECLINE -> cascade_respond_decline (advances to next candidate). confirmation + ACCEPT -> confirmation_confirm, + DECLINE -> confirmation_decline (frees slot -> DB trigger auto-starts a cascade).

nodes.name: agent_escalate
nodes.notes: Hands off to a human -> lands in the staff escalation_queue. No SMS is sent; staff take over the thread.

nodes.name: Slot action?
nodes.notes: True -> a cascade/confirmation ACCEPT or DECLINE that mutates a slot. False -> generic AI reply.

nodes.name: Call slot RPC
nodes.notes: One node for all four RPCs (URL is {{ $json.rpc }}). All take a single p_conversation_id and each resolves the conversation. cascade_respond_decline returns the still-free slot_id so we can advance the cascade.

nodes.name: Send acknowledgement
nodes.notes: Closes the loop with the patient who replied (a reply, not agent-initiated -> no opt-out line needed). Then, for a declined cascade, we advance.

nodes.name: Re-post to WF-B
nodes.notes: A declined cascade offer leaves the slot still 'cancelled' (no DB trigger fires), so we actively re-post it to WF-B's cascade webhook to offer the NEXT candidate. II_CASCADE_WEBHOOK_URL = WF-B's Production URL (same value as private.app_config.n8n_cascade_webhook_url).

nodes.name: Send reply
nodes.notes: Posts the generic AI answer with the service_role key -> lands in the /sms thread and staff /conversations console. Won't re-trigger n8n (agent messages don't fire the inbound trigger).

nodes.name: Debounce wait
nodes.notes: Gives a patient who splits a thought across several texts time to finish before we process any of them. Each inbound message gets its own execution and its own wait; agent_inbound_batch (next) discards every execution except the one for the newest message.

nodes.name: agent_inbound_batch
nodes.notes: Returns {proceed, conversation_id, joined_body}. proceed=false means a newer patient message has already arrived for this conversation -> this execution stops here.

nodes.name: Send cancel nudge
nodes.notes: Never cancels on the first ask. Sets cancel_pending so the next reply is read as confirm-cancel vs changed-mind-to-reschedule (see Cancel choice? below).

nodes.name: booking_cancel_dismiss
nodes.notes: Patient changed their mind and wants to reschedule instead of cancelling. Clears cancel_pending, then re-enters the normal assist/offer flow on the same message.

nodes.name: find_availability_window (fallback)
nodes.notes: The patient's primary doctor genuinely had nothing in this window (find_availability returned none, filtered by doctor_source=primary). Re-search with no doctor filter -> Mark substitute flags this for Build offer msg so it's framed as a one-time-only substitute, never a doctor change.
